methods.summary: Exact finite-local-group representation-support enumerator: subgroup/coset likelihood Fourier energy is d_pi times H-fixed multiplicity; local Haar-refresh evaluates the enumerator at e^{-2t}.

Complete all-degree bound for a global-parity alternative on a connected 1D pairwise Ising null using an exact degree-preserving Markov innovation basis; in the previously certified weak-coupling aligned interval natural single-site heat-bath gives TV convergence.

Sharp extremal interior weight-enumerator bound under a private-coordinate budget: W_C(z) <= (1+z^u)^M with equality only for disjoint size-u rows; repeated-common-overlap blocks worsen pressure per row as block size grows.

key_new_results: For Omega=Gamma^N and P uniform on H<=Omega, 1+G_h^rep(z)=sum_pi d_pi dim(V_pi^H) z^{wt(pi)} and local Haar-refresh gives 1+chi2(P S_t||Q)=W_H^rep(e^{-2t}).

For the free-boundary Ising chain with rho=tanh(epsilon), n=2q, and P=Q conditioned on full parity +1, Adv^{<=D} <= [2 C_rho^D/(1-|rho|^q)] (en/D)^{D/2} |rho|^{q-D/2}; therefore Adv^{<=D_n}->0 for D_n=(log n)^{1+eta}.
For the same chain chi2=(1-rho^q)/(1+rho^q)=O(1); combining with prior aligned weak-Ising heat-bath damping gives TV(P_n S_t,Q_n)->0 for every fixed t>0 on the certified weak-coupling interval.

Under at least u private coordinates per parity generator, W_C(z)<= (1+z^u)^M for 0<=z<=1, with equality at 0<z<1 exactly for disjoint size-u rows; no bounded generator-intersection degree or KP assumption is needed in this subclass.
For q rows sharing one common s-coordinate block and otherwise u private coordinates, B_q(z)=0.5[(1+z^s)(1+z^u)^q+(1-z^s)(1-z^u)^q] and B_q(z)^(1/q) is nondecreasing in q.
